facts.fact: Google does not publish average YouTube CPV or CPM figures.
facts.quote: Google does not publish average YouTube CPV or CPM. Any current average you see is an agency or vendor sample

facts.fact: Store Growers' 2026 YouTube cost table still rests on Strike Social reports from 2024 and Q2 2025.
facts.quote: Store Growers’ 2026 table still rests on Strike Social reports from 2024 and Q2 2025

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing lists daily budgets from $30 to $10,000 per day across its channels.
facts.quote: with daily budgets from [$30 to $10,000 per day](https://adwave.com/pricing/)

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing lists TikTok from $91 a day.
facts.quote: The [Adwave pricing page](https://adwave.com/pricing/) lists Google Search as included and TikTok from $91 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave charges no fee on media spend.
facts.quote: charges no fee on media spend, and credits undelivered media back

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing lists Google placements (YouTube and Demand Gen) as included alongside TV, Facebook and Instagram, Reddit and mobile web and apps.
facts.quote: Its pricing lists Google placements (YouTube and Demand Gen) as included alongside TV, Facebook and Instagram, Reddit and mobile web and apps

facts.fact: Adwave does not quote a fixed YouTube CPV or CPM; delivery costs follow the auction.
facts.quote: Adwave doesn’t quote a fixed YouTube CPV or CPM; delivery costs follow the auction like the ranges above.

facts.fact: TikTok on Adwave is opt-in and requires the user to turn it on in Customize and connect a TikTok account.
facts.quote: TikTok is live and opt-in: you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account.

facts.fact: If one optional channel cannot run at launch, the rest of an Adwave campaign still goes live.
facts.quote: if one optional channel can’t run at launch, the rest of the campaign still goes live

facts.fact: Which channels run on Adwave depends on budget, audience, creative and content eligibility.
facts.quote: The channels that actually run depend on budget, audience, creative and content eligibility

facts.fact: Adwave makes campaign ads from the advertiser's website.
facts.quote: Adwave makes the campaign ads from your website
